zh.summary: 跟进官方新内核，收敛插件管理入口，改善桌面边界与反馈入口。
highlights: 插件市场融入官方插件管理页；发现和安装插件后，可在官方列表统一启用、禁用和管理。
Windows 窗口恢复随明暗主题变化的细边框，活动窗口边界更清晰。
顶部帮助菜单增加项目仓库、Star 和建议入口；反馈问题可选择合适的模板。
加强插件声明的文件路径校验，拒绝绝对路径和父目录跳转。
upgradeNotes: 这是 0.7.0 的首个 Beta，使用候选通道，内置官方 DSH 0.1.6-alpha.2。
官方调整了插件加载与卸载接口，第三方插件的兼容性仍需由各插件确认。升级前请退出 Portable 并备份数据。
新内核包含官方 Office 文档处理组件，下载和解压体积较旧版增加；保留完整功能，未裁剪该组件。

en.summary: Follow the new official core, consolidate plugin management, and improve window boundaries and feedback access.
highlights: Open the plugin market from the official plugin manager, then manage installed plugins in the official inventory.
Restore a subtle, theme-aware Windows border to distinguish the active window.
Add repository, Star and suggestion links to the Help menu, with issue template selection for problem reports.
Strengthen validation of plugin-declared file paths by rejecting absolute paths and parent-directory traversal.
upgradeNotes: This first 0.7.0 Beta uses the candidate channel and bundles official DSH 0.1.6-alpha.2.
Official plugin loading and unloading interfaces have changed. Third-party plugin compatibility must be confirmed individually. Exit Portable and back up your data before upgrading.
The new core includes official Office document processing components, increasing download and extracted sizes. These components are retained in full.
